Class ChessFrame

java.lang.Object
chess.gui.ChessFrame
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameView
public final class ChessFrame extends Object implements GameView
The main window: the board in the center, a side panel with the turn indicator, game status, captured pieces, and move list, a message bar at the bottom, and a Game menu with New Game, Restart, and Exit.

This class is the View. It owns no game state: refresh() redraws everything from GameController.getGame(), which is what keeps the display consistent with the application state. It uses a JFrame rather than extending one (composition over inheritance), so its public methods are only the ones the controller needs.

    • SIDE_TEXT_WIDTH

      private static final int SIDE_TEXT_WIDTH
      Width at which side-panel text wraps. Swing's HTML renderer treats CSS "px" as points (1 pt = 4/3 screen pixels), so 175 here is about 233 pixels, which fits the 270-pixel side panel minus its 24 pixels of border.

    • wrap

      private static String wrap(String text)
      Wraps label text in HTML so it breaks onto more lines instead of being cut off with "..." when it is wider than the side panel. A plain JLabel never wraps.
      Parameters:
      text - the text to show; player names are limited to safe characters by GameSettings.checkName(String), so no HTML escaping is needed
      Returns:
      the text as HTML with a fixed wrapping width
